tool_args.rationale: The epidemic mobility bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the constant-gradient pilot leaves genuine ambiguity in sink dependence and branch structure. The open-branch probe directly addresses that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and the branch term are not adequately identified for transfer.
The bridge signature points to a static siphon mechanism; there is no evidence yet requiring a coupled trajectory model.
These remain competing smooth mechanisms, but the varying-gradient probe is needed to distinguish them.
